newsitem.title: USA: Wells Rich wins first big account since GGT bid.
newsitem.headline: Wells Rich wins first big account since GGT bid.

text.p: Citizens Utilities Co's Citizens Telecom said Thursday it named New York advertising agency Wells Rich Greene/BDDP to handle its first major ad campaign to build brand identity for its communications services.

For Wells Rich, this marks the first big account win since the London advertising company GGT Group proposed taking it over last month, following a long period of uncertainty as the agency's Paris-based BDDP owner sought a buyer.
Industry sources said the Citizens account will bring an estimated $12 million to $17 million in annual billings for the nation's 20th largest ad agency. Nine agencies pitched the account.
David Bello, vice president for marketing at Citizens, said the telecommunications company is hoping to build brand awareness among consumers in an increasingly cluttered telecommunications market.

In its first major branding effort, the 15th largest U.S. telecommunications company, known as a local service provider, hopes to raise awareness for its "portfolio of products," including local, long distance, cellular, paging and network services.
